reviews.text: Excellent availability, care and affection for the pets and their owners. I am very grateful.
Excellent service and they are always very caring with our family. They take the well-being of the animals and their care very seriously.
Great experience. On time, professional, caring and supportive.
Great service and excellent vets!  Highly recommend!

Excellent service, highly competent, dedicated, and caring professionals with the animals. The staff are equally friendly and attentive. I have two dogs who are now elderly and have been receiving treatment there for five years, since we arrived in Porto. I fully trust and recommend ARF.
Excellent clinic!

Clinic with excellent professionals.
Personalized service, care, and always with great affection for our pet.

I recommend it.

My 10-year-old beagle came into the clinic with 7 herniated discs, limited mobility, and excess weight. Today, I couldn't be more grateful because, despite the "ailments" still being there, my pet is already running, playing, and best of all, pain-free. What fantastic doctors! What professionalism, care, and affection they have for their "boys," as Dr. Bárbara so affectionately calls them.

Thank you!

Wonderful clinic. Dr. Katia is an excellent doctor. She always takes great care of our 4 chihuahuas. The staff are friendly and very polite. We feel very comfortable at the clinic, and so do our puppies. The environment is welcoming, calm, and suitable. We are big fans.
Thank you to the whole team! Congratulations!

I couldn't be more grateful to the entire clinic team, especially Dr. Bárbara, when Buda, my 7-year-old Weimaraner, swallowed a piece of a rubber bone (a toy that was actually suitable for dogs). Since we didn't realize it right away, we only became alarmed when he started vomiting and refusing food.

When we called the clinic, they advised us to go immediately. Upon palpation, Dr. Bárbara identified something unusual. As Buda had a history of a similar episode at 7 months old, they suggested an ultrasound for complete confirmation. With the diagnosis confirmed, hospitalization and surgery were immediate.

What made all the difference in the experience:

Communication and Empathy: We received constant updates throughout the day, which gave us enormous peace of mind.

Surgical Technique: The surgery went beautifully and they used internal sutures (no external stitches).

Post-Operative Care and Comfort: He was able to go home the same day! With no visible stitches, there was no need to wear the uncomfortable protective collar (the "funnel"), making recovery at home infinitely simpler and stress-free.

We only needed to return a few days later for a routine check-up to ensure the healing process was perfect.

Buda's care, professionalism, and genuine focus on well-being were exceptional. I recommend them without hesitation!
Professionalism and friendliness above all! A caring, helpful, and sensitive team!
Great professionalism and service.
So glad we found this clinic! Wonderful.
Excellent! The entire team is dedicated and very competent.
The service is always fantastic! You can tell they love animals.

Barbara, Ana and Maria are absolutely amazing! Everyone at the clinic is so friendly and welcoming to animals. Barbara is the first vet where Luna could be examined without trembling! 😍 She does her absolute best to keep pets calm, handling Luna with such sweetness and patience. She even allows her to wander around the consultation room and examines her on her own terms rather than forcing her onto the examination table. She genuinely loves animals and always explains everything in great detail. Super, super recommended! 💜

Plus, they have an in-house grooming service, which is super convenient.
Amazing staff, attentive and patient with both the animals and the owners.
Professional and dedicated team.

Five stars are not enough!

A fantastic team, incredibly professional, competent, and humane. They treat the animals with extraordinary care and dedication, as if they were their own. They are always kind, attentive, and available to answer any questions.

A very special mention goes to Dr. Bárbara, who is simply exceptional: professional, dedicated, competent, and always very caring with the animals and their owners. She inspires immense confidence and makes all the difference in the most important moments.

The facilities are excellent, modern, and very welcoming. It's a privilege to have such dedicated professionals committed to the well-being of our furry friends.

I wholeheartedly recommend them. ❤️🐾

My furry friends have been clients of this clinic since the very beginning, and we couldn't be more grateful for all the care, dedication, and professionalism. My Duke was cared for by Dr. Bárbara for 12 years, until his last breath. There aren't enough words to describe that day, nor all the support we received, both for our Duke and for us as his owners. It was a very difficult moment, but we always felt humanity, care, and immense sensitivity. We remain clients of Caboom and Simões, who don't know any other clinic and are always received with the same care and attention. It's a clinic we wholeheartedly recommend. We love and fully trust the entire team. Thank you for everything!

Excellent professionals! I recommend them 1000%.

We were facing a complicated situation, which was very well managed and resolved by Dr. Barbara and her entire team!

Very careful and, above all, genuine people.

A huge thank you for the fantastic support!

Barbara and team were fantastic with my dog Bonnie, who can be a reactive Swiss Shepherd. The service was efficient, friendly, and professional. I wouldn’t hesitate to return if I need a vet in Porto again!

I couldn't recommend this clinic more. Fantastic in every way, my dog ​​underwent surgery and from the beginning received all the support and dedication from both Dr. Cátia and Dr. Bárbara. They were and are lovely throughout the entire process. Thank you so much for the care you showed both my pet and us.
The best veterinarian, the most beloved and competent. I highly recommend her!

I would like to thank nurse Ana, whom I contacted a few weeks ago when our dog Alpha was in the final moments of her life, for her professionalism, empathy, and the care she showed during a very difficult time, even though we are not clients of ARF Veterinary Clinic. Thank you very much.

A clinic where the furry friends are truly family, I was so glad I went there with my little one, the service was top-notch, a super professional, highly competent team who are very concerned about the progress of the treatments.
Jackie Chan and I are very grateful.

I don't trust anyone else to take care of my animals (not at all 😅). Professionalism, dedication, and genuine affection for them. Furthermore, I know that nothing is left unthought, unconsidered, or undone at this clinic. The approach is extremely intelligent and always ahead of other clinics. I trust them completely because they do everything necessary and then some, paying attention to the smallest detail. I recommend them without any doubt.

I came to ARF because of joint problems my large senior dog was experiencing. She was meticulously studied and monitored for a year at ARF, with immense care, love, and dedication from everyone on the team. She improved dramatically – she went from crying and climbing onto the sofa to being active and playful again. There are no words to express my appreciation for everyone on the ARF team. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for allowing my girl to have a comfortable and fun last year of life. ✨

ARF is amazing! They have two excellent veterinarians who are always very attentive and careful. My Yorkshire Terrier is treated with great affection and dedication, and the clinic's groomer is fantastic. I recommend them without hesitation!

Thank you to Dr. Barbara, she was exceptional with Pit, who was much better the next day. She's adopted as Pit's doctor forever.

Thank you and lots of kisses from the three of us.

We went to the first appointment with my puppy and chose ARF because of the good Google reviews. What a pleasant surprise! Dr. Bárbara answered all our questions and was very helpful! The love that the entire ARF team has for animals is evident. She will be the one taking care of our Oliver for the rest of his life, I highly recommend her!
